correctness.rationale: Four-state de Bruijn matrices exactly encode cyclic preimages, including n=1 and n=2. Entrywise capping at two is a semiring homomorphism preserving trace==1. Independent code constructs all 410 capped product matrices and verifies the 410-coordinate exact integer vector identity T^3 sum_{j=0}^{14} q_j T^(14-j)f=0. Its formal-series recurrence and initial terms prove the rational formula for every n>=1. A second independent direct evaluator checks every binary input through length 18.

value.rationale: Singleton-predecessor target counts give the exact number of unambiguously reconstructible outputs of a standard nonlinear cellular automaton on every finite cyclic ring, a natural finer invariant than image cardinality or forbidden blocks. The explicit nontrivial rational series and complete finite-state integer certificate address a motivated inverse-problem gap; this is not a small cutoff extension, relabeling, or claimed general theorem beyond Rule 54.
